name: gi-uk-employment-pensions-treaty
description: UK–Gibraltar agreement treatment of employment remuneration, directors, entertainers, government service, students and pensions for 2026. Explains the cumulative 183-day short-stay conditions, separate offshore and crew rules, pension source taxation and Gibraltar same-income credit calculations. Includes boundary examples and evidence requirements. Identifies a conflict between HMRC's treaty summary and the published agreement on pensions and arbitration. Use when workers or pension recipients move between Gibraltar and the UK. This source-cited draft does not authorise payroll changes, establish social-security coverage or replace domestic filing procedures. Independent source review and professional attestation remain pending.
